title: The Borrowing Neighbor
synopsis: This time Little Ming’s mother is having trouble with a neighbor who likes to borrow things. In the end Little Ming’s mother has no choice but to put her foot down.

fullText.simplified:
爱借东西的邻居

    住在小明家对面的陈阿姨是个单身女人，她很爱找小明的妈妈聊天。这个陈阿姨有个坏习惯，就是喜欢借东西。
    一天，陈阿姨看到小明的妈妈正在用一把新扫把扫地，就对小明的妈妈说：“这把扫把真漂亮，能借我用两天吗？”小明的妈妈答应了。
    两天后陈阿姨来还扫把，又看到小明家新买的桌子，她又对小明的妈妈说：“明天我有几个朋友来家里玩，借你的新桌子用两天好吗？”小明的妈妈又答应了。
    两天后陈阿姨来还桌子，小明的爸爸正好出差回来，陈阿姨看到小明的爸爸那么帅，就自言自语地说：我真想有一个那么帅的老公。小明的妈妈听到后，很着急地对陈阿姨说：“这个可不能借给你。”
fullText.traditional:
愛借東西的鄰居

    住在小明家對面的陳阿姨是個單身女人，她很愛找小明的媽媽聊天。這個陳阿姨有個壞習慣，就是喜歡借東西。
    一天，陳阿姨看到小明的媽媽正在用一把新掃把掃地，就對小明的媽媽說：“這把掃把真漂亮，能借我用兩天嗎？”小明的媽媽答應了。
    兩天後陳阿姨來還掃把，又看到小明家新買的桌子，她又對小明的媽媽說：“明天我有幾個朋友來家裡玩，借你的新桌子用兩天好嗎？”小明的媽媽又答應了。
    兩天後陳阿姨來還桌子，小明的爸爸正好出差回來，陳阿姨看到小明的爸爸那麼帥，就自言自語地說：我真想有一個那麼帥的老公。小明的媽媽聽到後，很著急地對陳阿姨說：“這個可不能借給你。”

raw.synopsis: This time Little Ming’s mother is having trouble with a neighbor who likes to borrow things. In the end Little Ming’s mother has no choice but to put her foot down.
sentence_translations: A Neighbor Who Loves To Borrow Things
Across from Little Ming's house there lives a single woman, Aunt Chen.
She loves to call upon Little Ming's mom for a chat.
This Aunt Chen has a bad habit: she loves to borrow things.
One day Aunt Chen noticed Little Ming's mother using a new broom to sweep the floor.
She said to Little Ming's mother: “This broom is really nice, could you lend it to me for two days?”
Two days later Aunt Chen came to return the broom, and noticed the new table in Little Ming's house.
Again she asked Little Ming's mother: “I have some friends coming over tomorrow, can I borrow your new table for two days?”
Little Ming's mother once again agreed.
Two days later Aunt Chen came to return the table, and Little Ming's father was just returning home from a business trip.
Aunt Chen noticed Little Ming's father looking smart and said to herself: “I would really like to have a husband that handsome”
After Little Ming's mother heard her, and said anxiously: “I really cannot lend you that.”
